blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Office of the Ombudsman proposed to the Senate on Monday the formation of an in-house enforcement service to lessen its dependence on other law enforcement agencies in carrying out its mandate. Assistant Ombudsman PMGen. Eliseo DC Cruz and Assistant Ombudsman Atty. Luis Gonzaga Bonoan Jr. presented to the Senate panel on justice and human rights their recommendations on a Senate measure that will grant the office law enforcement powers. “The Office of the Ombudsman knows it could have caught more corrupt government personnel… if it is given the power to make lawful arrests and execute such entrapment […]...
